BiblicalUsage: gizbâr is a plain word for treasurer. In Ezra 7:21, the text says "do make a decree to all the treasurers which [are] beyond the river."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, gizbâr, does its job quietly — treasurer — and I leave it at that.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
